title: What If Your Sneeze Changed The Weather?

publish.title: What If Your SNEEZE Changed The Weather? #shorts
publish.description: What if every time you sneezed, the weather changed for the whole town? Which weather would you sneeze first?
publish.caption: What if your sneeze changed the weather? 🤧⛈️

scenes.line: What if your *sneeze* changed the weather?
scenes.title: WHAT IF...

scenes.line: It started on a normal, sunny *Tuesday*.
My nose started to *tickle*.
Achoo. It was *snowing*. In July.
Zoe stared at me. I stared at my *nose*.
I sneezed again. Now it was *windy*. Hats everywhere.
Third sneeze. A *rainbow*. Okay, that one was nice.
By lunch, I was the most popular kid in *school*.
Zoe opened a business. One dollar per *sneeze*.
Kids wanted snow days. I gave them *twelve*.
The ice cream man paid me for a *heatwave*.
I was rich. I was famous. I was very *sweaty*.
Then came the big math *test*.
And I caught a *cold*. A real one.
Achoo. *Rain*.
Achoo. *Sandstorm*. We do not even have sand.
Achoo. Blizzard. Achoo. *Fog*. I could not stop.
Then the biggest sneeze of my life. A *storm*.
The whole town hid *inside*. Because of my nose.
They rushed me to the *doctor*.
She looked in my nose and saw a tiny *cloud*.
It was stuck. It was scared. It was only a *baby*.
Every sneeze was just the cloud *crying* for home.
So I took a deep breath. And one last, gentle *sneeze*.
A tiny cloud floated out and up into the *sky*.
The storm ended. My nose was just a *nose* again.
Zoe was sad about the business. For about a *minute*.
Now she sells umbrellas. Just in *case*.
And sometimes one small cloud follows me to *school*.
If you see a rainbow on a Tuesday? You are *welcome*.
